messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

Each unit is the title of a song by the Beatles. Which one was first released on the album Beatles for Sale?

Units:
- Don't Pass Me By
- Come Together
- Got to Get You into My Life
- Getting Better
- Dig a Pony
- Money (That's What I Want)
- Mr. Moonlight
- Blue Jay Way
